methodSections.heading: Muesli
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F). Heat up the honey and olive oil in a saucepan until it is thin and runny. Roughly chop the walnuts and almonds.

Place the oats and almonds on two separate baking trays and place in the oven for 3 minutes. After 3 minutes, turn the oven off, only the residual heat is required for the rest of the roasting process.

Remove both trays from the oven. Add the walnuts to the almond tray. Form the oats into a pyramid shape and pour roughly ¼ of the honey and oil mixture on the top. Mix until most of the oats are evenly coated. Return both trays to the oven for 5 minutes.
Remove both trays from the oven again. Add raisins and coconut to the nut tray and mix ½ of the remaining honey and oil through the oats. Put both trays back into the oven for another 5 minutes.
Remove both trays from the oven and mix everything together, including the seeds and the remaining honey and oil.
Spread the muesli evenly over both trays and return to the oven for 5 minutes.
Stir the muesli around and then roast for a final 5 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow to cool completely, keep at room temperature in an airtight container.
Serve 1 Cup of muesli with fresh berries and enjoy with milk or yogurt.
